Hi Priya / team — thanks for the scope details. A few technical clarifications to help evidence collection: 

- Hosting & data residency: Redwood will deploy the inference endpoint in GCP (us-east1) for this POC. We can pin to a GCP project and region to meet residency needs.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest for model artifacts and customer artifacts. We provide KMS integration options (customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM).
- Network access: usually we provide an outbound-only connector (no inbound open ports). If you need VPC peering or private connectivity we can provide a detailed diagram.
- Logs & audit: request logs (request metadata only) are stored for 90 days by default; audit logs can be exported for longer retention to your S3/GCS if required.

I’ve attached a quick network stub (network-diagram-stub.png) and added a link to a shared folder for docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLink
